scope: Targeted real GPU inference credential lifecycle; not complete API-key or model coverage
identity: admin creates; copied inference bearer generates without admin cookies

cases.name: 推理令牌 / UI 创建复制并撤销 / 真实 GPU 流式与非流式生成成功，撤销后拒绝而 guard 仍可生成
prerequisites: Explicit remote base_url/node_uuid and private credentials
Runner creates an owned deployment on an explicitly selected idle real GPU; no fake engine
Runner verifies real container PID against GPU process and nonzero device memory
Browser trusts only the configured test origin for real clipboard readback; no product UI injection
Existing API keys remain intact; owned API-created guard keeps auth enabled during revocation

crud.Create: UI primary Create button creates key, exact POST/201, copy matches response and display
crud.Read: Independent GET and refresh prove metadata/prefix; real use updates last_used
crud.Update: N/A: inference-key UI/API offer no update operation
crud.Delete: UI cancel keeps generation working; confirm deletes, refresh removes row and same bearer receives 401

checklist_items.7.3: Once-only display, clipboard consumption, subsequent DOM/GET absence
checklist_items.7.4: Copied bearer generates; revoked bearer rejected while independent guard still generates
checklist_items.12.2: Named creation and secret dialogs/footer in viewport; delete confirmation reachable
checklist_items.12.7: Named-impact confirmation; cancel and actual deletion results
checklist_items.20.2: Actual public gateway request and meaningful real model output
checklist_items.20.3: Non-stream and SSE content, terminal DONE, finish reason, positive exact usage; cancel/error streams missing
checklist_items.21.1: Actual copy interaction and clipboard exact equality
checklist_items.21.5: Copied bearer consumed without rewriting; sensitive phase untraced and artifacts redacted

assertions: Public POST /v1/chat/completions with exact copied bearer returns real nonempty assistant content and usage
Streaming response has correct model, one request id, nonempty assembled content, finish_reason=stop, final DONE and usage
Prompt/completion token counts are positive; total equals their sum
Cancel deletion retains real generation access
Confirmed deletion causes generation request with old bearer to return 401 exact gateway denial
Anonymous generation remains denied while guard exists
Independent guard still produces real generation after target deletion
runtime.execution_evidence_owner: remote_gpu_fixture.verify_gpu: owned container, real GPU process and memory; no UI deployment-creation claim

cases.cleanup: Target deleted through UI; only run-owned guard deleted through API; pre-existing key metadata retained. Runner removes only its deployment/container and verifies baseline containers plus GPU memory restoration.
missing: GPU performance, dGPU isolation or sleep/wake
Deleting the last key through the UI while observing the gateway (after cleanup the zero-key /v1 401 is asserted in the inference-key case, not here)
